verses.ar:
صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ سَلَامُ اللَّهْ ۞ عَلَى طٰهٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهْ
صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ سَلَامُ اللَّهْ ۞ عَلَى يٰسٓ حَبِيبِ اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Ṣalātu Llāh salāmu Llāh, ʿalā Ṭāhā rasūli Llāh. Ṣalātu Llāh salāmu Llāh, ʿalā Yāsīn ḥabībi Llāh.
verses.en: May the prayers of Allah, may the peace of Allah, be upon Taha, the Messenger of Allah. May the prayers of Allah, may the peace of Allah, be upon Yasin, the beloved of Allah.

verses.ar:
تَوَسَّلْنَا بِبِسْمِ اللَّهْ ۞ وَبِالْهَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهْ
وَكُلِّ مُجَاهِدٍ لِلَّهْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Tawassalnā bi-bismi Llāh, wa-bi-l-hādī rasūli Llāh, wa-kulli mujāhidin li-Llāh, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: We seek intercession through the name of Allah, and by the Guide, the Messenger of Allah, and all who strive in the way of Allah, for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي سَلِّمِ الْأُمَّةْ ۞ مِنَ الْآفَاتِ وَالنِّقْمَةْ
وَمِنْ هَمٍّ وَمِنْ غُمَّةْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Ilāhī sallimi l-ummah, mina l-āffāti wa-n-niqmah, wa-min hammin wa-min ghummah, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: My Lord, grant the Ummah safety from hardship and adversity, and from worry and sorrow, for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي نَجِّنَا وَاكْشِفْ ۞ جَمِيعَ أَذِيَّةٍ وَاصْرِفْ
مَكَائِدَ الْعِدَا وَالْطُفْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Ilāhī najjinā wa-kshif, jamīʿa adhiyyatin wa-ṣrif, makā'ida l-ʿidā wa-l-ṭuf, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: My Lord, save us and deliver us from all harm and avert the schemes of our enemies and show us Your gentleness, for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي نَفِّسِ الْكُرَبَا ۞ مِنَ الْعَاصِينَ وَالْعَطْبَا
وَكُلِّ بَلِيَّةٍ وَوَبَا ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Ilāhī naffisi l-kurabā, mina l-ʿāṣīna wa-l-ʿaṭbā, wa-kulli baliyyatin wa-wabā, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: My Lord, relieve our afflictions, protect us from the disobedient and from ruin, and from every calamity and epidemic, for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
فَكَمْ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ حَصَلَتْ ۞ وَكَمْ مِنْ ذِلَّةٍ فَصَلَتْ
وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ وَصَلَتْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Fa-kam min raḥmatin ḥaṣalat, wa-kam min dhillatin faṣalat, wa-kam min niʿmatin waṣalat, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: How many mercies have been attained! And how much humiliation has been removed! And how many favours have been granted! For the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
وَكَمْ أَغْنَيْتَ ذَا الْعُمْرِ ۞ وَكَمْ أَوْلَيْتَ ذَا الْفَقْرِ
وَكَمْ عَافَيْتَ ذَا الْوِزْرِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Wa-kam aghnayta dhā l-ʿumri, wa-kam awlayta dhā l-faqri, wa-kam ʿāfayta dhā l-wizri, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: How many of the aged have You enriched! And how many of the destitute have You provided for! And how many sinners have You granted well-being! For the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
لَقَدْ ضَاقَتْ عَلَى الْقَلْبِ ۞ جَمِيعَ الْأَرْضِ مَعَ رَحْبِ
فَانْجُ مِنَ الْبَلَا الصَّعْبِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Laqad ḍāqat ʿalā l-qalbi, jamīʿa l-arḍi maʿa raḥbi, fa-nju mina l-balā ṣ-ṣaʿbi, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: Indeed, the whole earth, despite its vastness, feels constricted upon the heart, so save us from this severe affliction, for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
أَتَيْنَا طَالِبِي الرِّفْقِ ۞ وَجُلِّ الْخَيْرِ وَالسَّعْدِ
فَوَسِّعْ مِنْحَةَ الْأَيْدِي ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Ataynā ṭālibī r-rifqi, wa-julli l-khayri wa-s-saʿdi, fa-wassiʿ minḥata l-aydī, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: We come asking for mercy, and an abundance of goodness and felicity, so make Your gifts abundant, for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
فَلَا تَرْدُدْ مَعَ الْخَيْبَةْ ۞ بَلِ اجْعَلْنَا عَلَى الطَّيْبَةْ
أَيَا ذَا الْعِزِّ وَالْهَيْبَةْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Falā tardud maʿa l-khaybah, bali jʿalnā ʿalā ṭ-ṭaybah, ayā dhā l-ʿizzi wa-l-haybah, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: So do not send us away in disappointment, rather make us among the people of goodness, O Possessor of Honour and Majesty! For the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
وَإِنْ تَرْدُدْ فَمَنْ نَأْتِي ۞ بِنَيْلِ جَمِيعِ حَاجَاتِي
أَيَا جَالِي الْمُلِمَّاتِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Wa-in tardud faman na'tī, bi-nayli jamīʿi ḥājātī. Ayā jālī l-mulimmāti, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: And if You turn us away, to whom shall we go to have all our needs fulfilled? O Reliever of afflictions, grant us our needs for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي أَغْفِرْ وَأَكْرِمْنَا ۞ بِنَيْلِ مَطَالِبٍ مِنَّا
وَدَفْعِ مَسَاءَةٍ عَنَّا ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Ilāhī aghfir wa-akrimnā, bi-nayli maṭālibin minnā, wa-dafʿi masā'atin ʿannā, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: My Lord, forgive and honour us, by granting us our requests, and avert all harm from us, for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي أَنْتَ ذُو لُطْفٍ ۞ وَذُو فَضْلٍ وَذُو عَطْفٍ
وَكَمْ مِنْ كُرْبَةٍ تَنْفِي ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Ilāhī anta dhū luṭfin, wa-dhū faḍlin wa-dhū ʿaṭfin, wa-kam min kurbatin tanfī, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: My Lord, You are the Possessor of kindness, the Possessor of grace and compassion. How many afflictions have You dispelled, for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!

verses.ar:
وَصَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الْبَرِّ ۞ بِلَا عَدٍّ وَلَا حَصْرٍ
وَآلِ سَادَةٍ غُرٍّ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Wa-ṣalli ʿalā l-nabiyyi l-barri, bilā ʿaddin wa-lā ḥaṣrin, wa-āli sadātin ghurrin, bi-ahli l-badri Yā Allāh.
verses.en: And send prayers upon the Righteous Prophet, endlessly without enumeration, and upon his noble, radiant family, for the sake of the people of Badr, O Allah!
